Privacy-first architecture
The Problem

Your digital life is administered by someone else.

Your identityis controlled by platforms, not by you.
Your datais collected and monetised by third parties.
Your assetsdepend on intermediaries you did not choose.
Your AIoperates inside systems you do not control.

ABYSS is designed so that identity, assets, permissions and AI operate under the user's cryptographic control — not platform-owned, not permissioned by default, not dependent on a single intermediary.

What Is ABYSS

One protocol. Three levels of depth.

The same underlying protocol operates at three levels. Each is fully usable on its own — nothing above Level 1 is required.

LEVEL 01

ABYSS Blockchain

The foundation. A privacy-first blockchain: private transactions, wallet infrastructure, cryptographic identity, consensus, and the native AC economy.

Use directly — no additional software required.
LEVEL 02

ABYSS Runtime

An execution environment that brings ABYSS Account, Native AI and private storage to Windows, macOS or Linux — without replacing your operating system.

Optional. Installs alongside your existing OS.
LEVEL 03

ABYSS OS

A complete sovereign operating environment. Identity, applications, AI and assets integrated into one system, built around the same protocol.

Optional. The deepest layer, not a requirement.
ABYSS OS is optional. A wallet and the base protocol are enough for most users. Depth is a choice, not a requirement — the infrastructure works identically at every level.

Technology

Privacy. Consensus. Intelligence.

Three technological layers engineered as one protocol.

01 — PRIVACY

Zero-Knowledge Cryptography

Designed to prove transaction validity without exposing unnecessary transaction data.

Shielded Transactions

Privacy engineered as a protocol-level capability, not an optional application feature.

Selective Disclosure

Prove a specific attribute — age, uniqueness, eligibility — without revealing the underlying data.

02 — CONSENSUS

Rotating-Leader BFT

Byzantine fault-tolerant consensus with per-round leader rotation, validator quorum and view-change recovery.

Validator Coordination

No single validator holds standing authority — the leader role rotates by protocol rule every round.

Permissionless Target

The long-term network is designed around open validator participation, not a fixed operator set.

03 — AI

Native AI Agents

Personal AI agents designed to operate strictly under explicit, user-defined permissions.

Policy-Controlled Actions

An agent can only perform actions permitted by its owner's policy — nothing implicit, nothing default-on.

Verifiable Execution

The architecture targets cryptographically verifiable AI actions without granting the AI unrestricted authority.

AI should be powerful. But never sovereign over the user.

The Deepest Layer

ABYSS OS — entirely optional.

For users who want the full environment. Not required to use ABYSS as a blockchain.

What it combines

  • Sovereign identity across every application
  • Native AI as a system-level process, not a plugin
  • Blockchain-native applications and permissions
  • Protocol-level privacy across the environment

What it does not require

  • Replacing Windows, macOS or Linux
  • Adopting the OS to use ABYSS as blockchain infrastructure
  • Any change to how Level 1 or Level 2 already work
The Token

ABYSS Coin — AC

55,000,000 AC
HARD CAP — NO DISCRETIONARY INCREASE, EVER

AC is the economic resource of the ABYSS protocol: transaction settlement, compute, storage and governance. The maximum supply is fixed in the tokenomics engine — not a policy that can be revisited.

Distribution

Team Reserve — 30,000,000 AC (54.5%) — locked at genesis, 5-year vesting
Public / Investor Distribution — 25,000,000 AC (45.5%)

Team Reserve is 100% locked at genesis. Tranche A (10,000,000 AC) unlocks linearly over Year 1. Tranche B (20,000,000 AC) unlocks linearly over Years 2–5, capped at 5,000,000 AC per year. No discretionary early unlocks — all schedules are enforced on-chain.

⚠ IMPORTANT — READ BEFORE INVESTING

Following the close of Stage 1, eligible investors may be given access to a defined peer-to-peer secondary window at a reference price of $3.00/AC.

ABYSS does not guarantee liquidity. ABYSS does not guarantee a buyer. ABYSS does not guarantee a return. Any secondary transaction depends entirely on an available counterparty and the published rules of the window at that time.

The $3.00 figure is a proposed reference price within the mechanism — not a redemption value, not a buyback commitment, and not a promise of profit.

Full mechanics and eligibility requirements are published in PRESALE_STRATEGY.md before activation.
